caption: The drawing depicts a side view of a mask-like object resembling a human head with exaggerated and stylized features. The head is brown with shading to indicate contours and depth, and it has a large, prominent nose that is rounded at the tip. The eye is round, greyish, and bulges outward with a small, dark pupil and accented with black lines and shading. The lips are thick, full, and painted in a deep red color. Two thin, black wires or strings protrude vertically from the top of the head. A segmented, textured strip, dark in color (appearing black or very dark brown), runs down the back of the head, giving the appearance of a mane or hair. The base of the neck area is circled with a red band or ribbon. The background of the image is a plain, light beige color, and in the bottom left corner, the name "WEISER" is written in small, black letters. The overall composition centers the head within the border of the image, focusing on the profile view and the details of the materials and construction.
title: Marionette (Detail)
